concepts.canonical_verified_statement: An ionic solid consists of cations and anions arranged in an extended lattice held together by electrostatic attractions.
A molecular solid consists of discrete molecules held together in the solid by intermolecular forces.
A Lewis electron-dot structure represents valence electrons and bonding connections using element symbols, lines, and dots.
Formal charge assigns bonding electrons equally between bonded atoms and compares the assigned electrons with the atom's valence-electron count.
